items.title: Zeke Mullins interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 9, 2017
items.q: Eisenhower, Bush, what’s the other, what’s the man that’s been there so long?

ctx.x: I read that you played at the White House three times.
Yeah. Well no, about four times. Eisenhower, Bush, what’s the other, what’s the man that’s been there so long?
